title: Đom đóm
about: Round x14, two more to fill the album, as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm 2 bài nữa để đủ album"): sleep music in the style of albums 6-8, slow (50 bpm), pad, shimmer, sub, an improvised glass tune, then box. An original piece.
